name: Payroll
description: Payroll calculation done by the kernel.

capabilities.name: Calculate Payslips
capabilities.description: Calculate payslips with the Swift payroll engine inside the kernel, natively and on every core, instead of in the plugin's WebAssembly. Compiled salary structures are kept between calls, and payslip lines can be kept in the kernel and written by it, so they never pass through the plugin. Maps to kernel commands payroll::calculate, payroll::write and payroll::sum_lines.
